abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.description: Deals damage before receiving in round 1. If the opponent is defeated in round 1, this unit takes no damage.

abilities.name: Guardian
abilities.description: Survives one lethal hit per match at 1 Stamina.

abilities.name: Martyr
abilities.description: When this unit is defeated, the next allied unit gains +2 Power.

abilities.name: Rallier
abilities.description: On win, the next allied unit gains +1 Stamina.

abilities.name: Resolve
abilities.description: Once per match, if both units would be defeated simultaneously, this unit survives at 1 Stamina.

abilities.name: Steal
abilities.description: At the start of this duel, takes the opposing unit's ability. The opponent loses it permanently. Warden uses it this duel only.

abilities.name: Vanguard
abilities.description: If this is the first unit played this battle, gains +2 Power.

abilities.name: Warcry
abilities.description: Gains +1 Power and +1 Stamina for every 5 allied units in the discard stack when this unit enters combat.
